conclusion.label: endorses

report:
**Conclusion**  
The claim is supported by scientific evidence. Consuming higher amounts of olive oil is associated with a reduced risk of stroke.

**Key Findings**
* **Meta-Analytic Evidence:** Systematic reviews and meta-analyses combining prospective cohort, case-control, and intervention studies demonstrate that higher olive oil intake is inversely associated with stroke risk and overall cardiovascular events (https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/british-journal-of-nutrition/article/olive-oil-consumption-and-risk-of-chd-andor-stroke-a-metaanalysis-of-casecontrol-cohort-and-intervention-studies/79A90337470271D8A8CE2FDC77BD869E, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9623257/).
* **Clinical Trial Support:** The landmark PREDIMED randomized primary prevention trial demonstrated that adopting a Mediterranean diet enriched with extra virgin olive oil significantly reduced major cardiovascular events, reporting approximately a 33% reduction in stroke risk (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29897866/, https://myhealthcare.com/Food/Olive_Oil/index.html).
* **Biological Mechanisms:** The protective association is supported by biological mechanisms; extra virgin olive oil improves endothelial function, decreases thrombotic tendency, and reduces platelet aggregation (https://myhealthcare.com/Food/Olive_Oil/index.html).

While observational studies alone can present confounding factors, the alignment of findings across large observational cohorts and randomized clinical trial data provides robust evidence for olive oil’s protective role against stroke.

**Sources Cited**
* Meta-Analysis in British Journal of Nutrition: https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/british-journal-of-nutrition/article/olive-oil-consumption-and-risk-of-chd-andor-stroke-a-metaanalysis-of-casecontrol-cohort-and-intervention-studies/79A90337470271D8A8CE2FDC77BD869E
* Meta-Analysis on Cardiovascular Outcomes: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9623257/
* PREDIMED Trial (PubMed): https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29897866/
* Olive Oil Health Overview: https://myhealthcare.com/Food/Olive_Oil/index.html
